content.text: how to show the symbol for the super keys, such as command and opt?

Question not code task. Plan mode irrelevant here — just answer.

Mac symbols:

⌘ Command
⌥ Option
⇧ Shift
⌃ Control
⇥ Tab
⏎ Return
⌫ Delete
⎋ Escape
␣ or Space word
↑ ↓ ← → arrows
⇪ Caps Lock

Type via Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space) or just copy-paste. In SwiftUI KeyboardShortcut, macOS auto-renders these symbols in menus — no manual work needed.
